q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: WITH TEMP AS(SELECT DISTINCT A.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWERS, A.FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW A JOIN FOLLOW B ON A.FOLLOWEE = B.FOLLOWEE WHERE A.FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW)) SELECT FOLLOWERS AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM TEMP GROUP BY FOLLOWERS ORDER BY FOLLOWER

counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when there is a user who is both a follower and a followee of another user.
